hero.title: Deposit your work. Date it.
hero.subtitle: The digital deposit platform of the National Copyright and Related Rights Office, for safely preserving your unpublished creative works.
deposit.heading: What you can deposit
deposit.intro: The Office accepts digital deposits of creative and intellectual works of various kinds.
howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.step1.title: Create your account
howItWorks.step1.description: Enter your details to create a verified platform account.
howItWorks.step2.title: Upload your file
howItWorks.step2.description: Upload your work in any supported format, up to 5 GB per file.
howItWorks.step3.title: Receive your deposit receipt
howItWorks.step3.description: Get a receipt documenting the date your work was deposited with the Office.
guarantees.heading: What we guarantee
guarantees.fileSize: You can upload files up to 5 GB in size.
guarantees.resumable: If an upload is interrupted, it resumes where it stopped — it does not start over.
guarantees.storage: Your files are stored on the Office's servers in Algeria.
guarantees.checksum: Each file's integrity is verified by checksum on arrival.
closing.heading: Start depositing your work today
